summary: Tested new Stripe donations feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed (packages endpoint, checkout with preset & custom, min/max validation, invalid package, no-selection, status endpoint, webhook route, unknown-session 404). Security check confirmed: extra 'amount' field from client is ignored — seed preset always resolves to 5000 minor units (50 RON) server-side. Frontend: /doneaza page renders stripe-panel with all 4 presets + custom + custom input + pay button, and IBAN bank-transfer card with copy button and external link intact. Clicking donate-card-btn with 'brick' preset selected redirected browser to checkout.stripe.com showing RON 250.00 (matching server-defined package amount).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py donations/checkout correctly resolves amount server-side from DONATION_PACKAGES or bounded custom_amount (5..50000). Extra client-supplied 'amount' field is ignored by Pydantic model — verified.
donation_status endpoint is idempotent: only writes if payment_status != 'paid'.
Webhook endpoint /api/webhook/stripe exists and validates signature (returns 400 on invalid sig, which is correct).
Payment transaction record properly created on checkout with pending/initiated state, amount, currency, metadata (verified via status endpoint returning amount_total).
Frontend Donate.jsx correctly sends only origin_url + (package_id | custom_amount) — never sends amount field.
seed_data_creation: Multiple payment_transactions records created during checkout tests (pending, non-completed sessions). No cleanup needed — Stripe sessions expire naturally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe donations verified with test key sk_test_emergent. Preset packages: seed=50/candle=100/brick=250/pillar=500 RON. Custom bounds 5..50000 RON. All backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_donations.py, run: pytest backend/tests/test_donations.py. Do NOT complete card payment on hosted stripe page during automated tests — only verify redirect.
